notes.title: Bravium update Jan.16
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. The patch 1.0.10 with some balance fixes is available now.

ver. 1.0.10

- Bone levels missions requirements were decreased.
- Increased damage from bosses and minibosses of forest and cave levels.
- Piercing crossbows damage was slightly decreased.
- Stun and freeze are no more canceled by attacks.

notes.title: Bravium update Jan.09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, there is an update with some fixes.

ver. 1.09 
- Challenge and raid stuck bug fixed
- Game's difficulty can now be changed in the settings menu
- Fixed bug that causes rabbits deal only half damage
